text_blocks.snippet: A visitor management system (VMS) is a digital tool used to track, manage, and register guests, contractors, and clients who enter a facility.
snippet_highlighted_words: a digital tool used to track, manage, and register guests, contractors, and clients who enter a facility

list.snippet: Pre-Registration: Hosts invite visitors ahead of time via email or SMS, sending QR codes or passcodes for easy entry.
Self-Check-In: Guests arrive and use a lobby tablet or touchscreen kiosk to scan their code, take a photo, or fill out required details.
Host Notification: The system instantly alerts the specific employee or host that their guest has arrived.
Badge Printing: The software automatically prints a visitor pass or temporary ID badge.
Sign-Out and Logs: Visitors check out when leaving, while digital logs store historical data for safety audits.
Better Security: Screens visitors, tracks who is inside the building in real-time, and restricts unauthorized entry.
Time Savings: Replaces slow paper logbooks with automated check-ins, reducing front-desk workload.
Compliance: Collects digital signatures on non-disclosure agreements (NDAs) and maintains strict records for privacy laws.
